integrity: All constants are roots of displayed integer polynomials; finite direct matrix checks complement rather than replace the exact all-step sign proof. The claim does not reassert as new the established eight-state dimension barrier or failure of [2/2] Pade absolute monotonicity.
scientific_limitations: A complete all-step result for the homogeneous rate-one directed eight-cycle only. Neither other cycle sizes nor heterogeneous rates nor internal Runge--Kutta stage positivity are classified. Equivalent unpublished or unindexed specialization remains a scientific originality risk.
title: Exact positivity window of fourth-order Gauss integration on an eight-state directed ring
